app_subtitle: Log, itinerary, and photo catalog of our family adventure through Argentina (October 2025).
footer_note: Independent app — in production save the API Key in the backend (Vercel) environment variables.
drag_overlay_desc: Release to start geolocating and importing
main_drop_zone_desc: or click to select files from your computer
batch_limit_warning: For performance reasons and to avoid saturating the system, the maximum limit is 20 photos per batch. Only the first 20 photos will be processed.
batch_timespan_warning: For optimal matching and propagation results, we recommend uploading batches taken within an interval of less than 1 hour.
map_error: Error loading the map. Verify your connection or API Key.
manual_geo_alert: Click on the main map to assign location to this photo.
hitl_subtitle: Human review queue for pending records with medium confidence validation (40% - 75%).
hitl_empty: There are no records pending review in the queue.
confirm_cancel_batch: Are you sure you want to cancel batch import? All progress will be lost.
consent_desc: Uses real photo coordinates to suggest places.
use_picarta_desc: If the photo has no GPS, AI tries to guess the place by the landscape.
search_radius_desc: Precision of the search circle around the photo.
anonymize_desc: Rounds the exact location to protect your privacy.
strip_exif_desc: Deletes all technical information (GPS, date) when downloading.
confirm_delete_album: Are you sure you want to delete this album and all its saved photos?
confirm_merge_album: Do you want to merge all photos from this album with the selected one?
